checks.detail: Sheet header is Total anchors: 229, consecutive A1–A229, matching verify anchors 229 and failures 0. Six named documents exist. Gate DEEPEN because independent review had not passed matches this review not yet having been saved. Object census 226 (92 claims, 5 concepts, 19 entities, 1 guide, 109 sources), 67 derived blocks, and 30 dual-source claims were not re-counted; nothing read contradicts them.

229/229 pairing-sheet anchors compared. No document sentence adds a number, upgrades a pilot to a completed rollout, or widens one site to the industry beyond the claim statement and quotes. Modal drops, the decree paraphrase, the FECON tense, and the alert-fatigue failure-mode verb are non-blocking under the assumptions in the report. Two derived sentences in tong-quan are stale or internally inconsistent and understate or over-caution; they are not C2 overstatements.

Pairing-sheet text matches the raw lines checked in all six documents, including tong-quan adoption and ROI, robotics tiers and Komatsu/Cat, llm bounded extraction, cong-truong 4S and SmartRock, vong-doi BRG and vendor cases, and ha-tang A183–A229 through the failure modes.

18 claims confirmed verbatim in frozen captures, at least one in each required topic: robotics (Nghị định 288, Komatsu 11.5 billion tonnes, Skillings Bull Run production wording, ETS acceptance), LLM/OCR (FLAIRS 94.3% F1 and bounded extraction, AECV-Bench, Procore Title dictionaries, pdftotext result), digital site (DEVB 4S/60%/20%, Giatec can-reduce, ISARC alert-fatigue abstract), lifecycle/enterprise (BRG survey, savings, ROI, liability; RICS >2,200 and <1%; NBS >1,000 and 67% CDE; Istanbul majority; FECON; Skanska 1,000/500 with Source: Skanska).

(a) Vendor performance figures in the six documents are attributed with công bố/tự công bố/theo/báo cáo. (b) llm When NOT and the overview forbid đọc hiểu spec and limit evidence to bounded extraction. (c) 10,79% Eurostat, 75% APM, and under 1% RICS stay on separate denominators; averaging is forbidden. (d) Mining haulage is the proven production tier; construction machines are thương mại sơ khởi; Komatsu and Caterpillar are not added. (e) No measured production case at a Vietnamese site; FECON is a press introduction, camera/flycam is not camera AI, Coteccons Workday is an HR platform.

All six documents have Purpose, When to Use / When NOT, Core Knowledge Content, then Failure Modes (Mandatory), with 12, 11, 12, 9, 8, and 13 failure modes. Vietnamese sampled across all six has diacritics and is grammatical. No sentence in that sample would mislead a construction engineer on a rate, a licence trigger beyond the non-blocking decree paraphrase, or a Vietnamese production case.

findings.issue: Derived text says the pack does not record the BRG sample size. Line 149 and the BRG capture record more than 100 executives.
findings.fix: Replace with hơn 100 lãnh đạo xây dựng và phát triển dự án.

findings.issue: Calls the respondent-share reading of BRG phase rates an inference, while ai-vong-doi states that reading as what the survey says. The press release gives the percentages from survey responses and does not write 'of respondents' on that clause.
findings.fix: Use one wording: percentages come from the survey of more than 100 executives; do not call that reading a mere inference and do not add the words 'percent of respondents' as if the press release used them.

findings.issue: Derived table line 102 and failure mode line 190 drop có thể. The body and the Giatec quote say steel formwork and dense rebar can reduce Bluetooth signal strength. The same drop is at ha-tang line 261 (A221), làm yếu.
findings.fix: Restore có thể in the derived table and both failure modes.

findings.issue: Failure mode says dense equipment alarms khiến công nhân chai lì. The body says the paper argues this and that alert fatigue needs to be measured. The abstract defines the phenomenon and proposes an experiment; it does not report a site result.
findings.fix: Say the paper defines alert fatigue and proposes a measurement experiment.

findings.issue: Decree sentences (also A72, A133, A208) shorten bay theo chương trình cài đặt sẵn thông qua bộ điều khiển trung tâm to chương trình lập sẵn, and omit the 0,25 kg visual-licence threshold. The claim statement uses the same shorter trigger.
findings.fix: Restore thông qua bộ điều khiển trung tâm and mention the 0,25 kg visual licence.

findings.fix: Use còn phát triển or attribute the tense to the article.
